summary: Saskatchewan tower site where a modern steel tower replaced the old lookout in 1965; towermen are listed to 2002. No source describes the site today.

events.note: Old lookout structure replaced by a modern steel tower, per the DNR annual report for 1965-66
Towerman listed as Wesley Dimon (the tower listing spells it Wes Dimion, dated 68-9)

evidence.supports: Old lookout replaced by a modern steel tower in 1965, per the DNR annual report 1965-66
evidence.quote: The old lookout structure was replaced with a modern steel tower. (Department of Natural Resources Annual Report, 1965-66)

evidence.supports: Towerman Wesley Dimon listed for Nelson Hill in 1968
Thomas Ouellette listed for Nelson Hill 1996-2002; entry ends with the aerial detection note
evidence.quote: Thomas Ouellette 1996-2002 Nelson Hill went to aerial detection

evidence.supports: Department described as now called SERM, in the Grassy Lake towerman's biography on the same list (not a Nelson Hill entry)
evidence.quote: Saskatchewan Department Of Natural Resources (now called Saskatchewan Environment and Resource Management or SERM)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The listing gives 68-9 and the towermen list gives 1968; both put the start in 1968, so they are read as agreeing. The pages spell the name differently (Dimion, Dimon) and do not say more.

notes_for_editor: The brief's agency field (Saskatchewan Public Safety Agency, formerly DNR) is not supported by any page read; the towermen page says the department is now called SERM and does not mention the Public Safety Agency. The facts.agency value is the DNR, which the 1965-66 report supports. Listing notes give 1965 and 1966; 1966 is unexplained and not used. The 1965 replacement is taken from Canada Lookouts, which compiles the DNR annual reports; the report itself was not read. No source describes the present condition, removal or access. Brief status and access are left unset.
